attackers_goals: Get access to credentials, data or an organization via applications with sufficient permissions.
description: An identity consented permissions to an application.
investigative_actions: Follow further actions by the consenting user. Check for new resource creations by the new user. Check how the consenting user got to the application. Verify the application creators. Check what permissions the application requested. Check for possible phishing in the organization.
name: Azure application consent
